verdictEs: WFInfo si solo quieres el price-check de recompensas de relic: gratis, open source, liviano y sin pedir nada. AlecaFrame si quieres una suite companion completa que además gestione inventario, foundry, rivens y trading, a costa de ser más pesada y cerrar los analytics avanzados detrás de Patreon.
verdictEn: WFInfo if you only want relic-reward price-checking: free, open source, lightweight and asking nothing. AlecaFrame if you want a full companion suite that also manages inventory, foundry, rivens and trading, at the cost of being heavier and closing advanced analytics behind Patreon.

useCases.labelEs: Elegir la mejor recompensa de relic en un fissure
useCases.labelEn: Pick the best relic reward in a fissure
useCases.reasonEs: Es la función central de WFInfo, gratis y de propósito único; lo hace perfecto sin el overhead de una suite completa.
useCases.reasonEn: It's WFInfo's core function, free and single-purpose; it does it perfectly without the overhead of a full suite.

useCases.labelEs: Gestionar inventario y listar en Warframe Market en un click
useCases.labelEn: Manage inventory and list on Warframe Market in one click
useCases.reasonEs: AlecaFrame lee tu inventario y publica ventas al mercado sin copiar nombres a mano; WFInfo no gestiona inventario.
useCases.reasonEn: AlecaFrame reads your inventory and posts sales to the market without copying names by hand; WFInfo doesn't manage inventory.

useCases.labelEs: Querer una tool open source y auditable
useCases.reasonEs: WFInfo es open source bajo Apache-2.0; AlecaFrame no expone su código, lo que pesa para quien corre software que lee la pantalla.
useCases.reasonEn: WFInfo is open source under Apache-2.0; AlecaFrame doesn't expose its code, which matters for those running screen-reading software.

useCases.labelEs: Cazar y evaluar rivens con analytics de mercado
useCases.labelEn: Sniping and evaluating rivens with market analytics
useCases.reasonEs: El explorador de rivens y las analytics de AlecaFrame no tienen equivalente en WFInfo, que solo cubre relics.
useCases.reasonEn: AlecaFrame's riven explorer and analytics have no equivalent in WFInfo, which only covers relics.

useCases.labelEs: Correr algo liviano sin Overwolf ni Patreon
useCases.labelEn: Running something lightweight without Overwolf or Patreon
useCases.reasonEs: WFInfo es un overlay liviano y gratuito; AlecaFrame depende de Overwolf y cierra sus features avanzadas tras Patreon.
useCases.reasonEn: WFInfo is a lightweight, free overlay; AlecaFrame depends on Overwolf and gates its advanced features behind Patreon.
